aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description: I'm a Software Development Technical student at ITSE (Instituto Tecnico Superior Especializado) in Panama, studying since January 2025. Besides my academic projects, I have previous experience as a Development Assistant, where I collaborated in building commercial management software. I enjoy working across the entire application lifecycle: from database design to the user interface, with a special interest in Angular, PHP/Laravel and relational database schema design.
